description: Complete the Spark performance tuning configuration and queries.
expectedOutput:
When completed correctly, this code will:
1. Enable Adaptive Query Execution (AQE) for runtime optimization
2. Use broadcast hint for small table joins
3. Apply Liquid Clustering on frequently filtered columns
4. Cache hot tables in memory
5. Set shuffle partitions based on data size
hints: spark.sql.adaptive.enabled is the AQE config key
The broadcast join threshold is configured in bytes; consult the Databricks runtime configuration reference for the current default.
OPTIMIZE is the Delta Lake file compaction command
Cluster by columns most used in WHERE clauses
CACHE TABLE loads data into memory for faster access
BROADCAST hint tells Spark to broadcast the smaller table
learnings: broadcast() hints for small table joins
explain() shows the query execution plan
